flowchart TD
 A["Stop ends the active response and preserves Chat state"] --> B["Next input or exact request recovery"]
 B --> C["Load persisted execution for this Chat and Run"]
 C --> D["Validate requested tool configuration against current adapter"]
 D --> E["Use original native tool descriptions from the persisted binding"]
 E --> F["Keep MCP definitions and all schemas, credentials, limits and permission checks strict"]
 F --> G{"Original frozen snapshot and authority match"}
 G -->|Yes| H["Continue with original snapshot and fresh invocation identity"]
 G -->|No| I["Reject actual authority change before effects"]
 H --> J["Never replay cancelled tools or rewrite prior history"]

data.title: Stop and continue preserve frozen tool descriptions
